text: Sketching a black panther at the Central Park Zoo, Serbian illustrator Irena Dubrovna meets engineer Oliver Reed and marries him, though she believes she [descends from a village of cat people|origin|family blood and inheritance] and will [become a panther if roused to passion|rules|the body changes]. She never consummates the marriage. When Oliver confides in his assistant Alice, Irena's [jealousy follows Alice through the dark|threat|people in your own life], along a night street and into a basement pool where an animal stalks her, and Alice later finds [her bathrobe torn to shreds|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes].
